reviews.title: Couldn’t Start a Lesson
reviews.text:
TL;DR - I couldn’t start a lesson because I was repeatedly prompted to sign up for a free trial or purchase a subscription. 

Full Review:
I downloaded the app, excited to find a tool to help replace social media. I signed up for an account, selected my topics, and chose a journey to dive into. When I tapped on the first lesson, a pop-up appeared prompting me to start a free trial. I prefer to avoid those because I forget to cancel them. When I exited that screen, another appeared offering a discount. I cleared it, tapped the first lesson, and was met with the same “sign up for a free trial” message, then with the discount offer.

I deleted my account and then deleted the app. I don’t want to sign up for a free trial that I may forget to cancel. I don’t want to purchase an app I haven’t had the ability to experience. I’m more likely to start a free trial if I’ve repeatedly used the app for several days. I’m more likely to purchase the app or subscription if I’m impressed by the free trial. 

I’d give 0 stars if I could since I can’t realistically speak for the content or experience.

reviews.title: Deceptive billing — $0.99 trial turned into $74.99 yearly charge
reviews.text:
I signed up for Imprint after seeing a 99-cent trial. I paid the $0.99 and expected either a short trial or monthly billing. About a month later I was hit with a $74.99 charge for a full yearly subscription. The charge came directly from Imprint, not through Apple.
This feels like a bait-and-switch. The low trial price is used to get payment info, then a much larger annual charge appears with little clear warning that a full year was being locked in. Canceling and getting the money back has been difficult. I would not recommend this app based on the billing practices alone.

reviews.title: 76$ SCAM
reviews.text:
I’m extremely disappointed with the Imprint app and their billing practices. The app advertised free cancellation until November 21, but I was charged before the cancellation window ended. I was planning to cancel because I didn’t like the app and only used it once during the trial.
As soon as I saw the charge, I emailed their support team requesting a refund and cancellation, but I never received any response. It’s very frustrating to be charged early and then be ignored when trying to resolve the issue.
If the company advertises free cancellation until a certain date, they should honor that timeline and allow users to cancel before charging them.
I’m still hoping the Imprint team will refund the charge and confirm cancellation, but so far the lack of support makes this feel like a scammy experience.
